text: The user is planning a trip to Miami and is considering flying with American Airlines. On 10 February 2023 the user had a terrible experience with American Airlines' in-flight entertainment system on a flight from New York to Los Angeles.

The assistant said American Airlines offers seat-back touchscreens on most aircraft, including the Boeing 737-800, 777-200 and Airbus A321T, and tablet-based entertainment on some aircraft such as the Boeing 737 MAX and Airbus A321.

The assistant said that on select American Airlines aircraft, passengers can stream content to their own laptop, tablet or smartphone through the American Airlines app, and that the content includes movies, TV shows, music, games and live TV on some flights.

The assistant said American Airlines customer service can be reached by phone on the reservations number 1-800-433-7300 in the US, through online chat, email or a complaint form, and on Twitter at @AmericanAir and Facebook.

The assistant cited American Airlines customer service ratings of Skytrax 3/5 stars from over 22,000 reviews, TripAdvisor 3.5/5 stars from over 33,000 reviews, and Consumer Reports 64/100 from a survey of over 18,000 passengers.

The assistant said American Airlines rebooks passengers on the next available flight, including partner airline flights, after a delay or cancellation, and may offer vouchers, hotel stays or meal allowances if a passenger is significantly delayed or stranded overnight.
In this session on 10 February 2023 the user said they were still concerned about checked bag fees and planned a week-long trip to Miami for which they would likely need to check a bag.

The assistant said American Airlines' first checked bag costs $30 online or $40 at the airport for Main Cabin tickets, is free on Premium Economy, Business and First Class tickets, and that the second checked bag costs $40 online or $50 at the airport.

The assistant said American Airlines checked bags must not exceed 62 inches (157 cm) in combined length, width and height or 50 pounds (23 kg), and carry-on bags must fit within 22 inches (56 cm) tall, 14 inches (36 cm) wide and 9 inches (23 cm) deep.
The assistant warned that Basic Economy tickets on American Airlines do not allow a free checked bag, even for elite loyalty program members.

The assistant said American Airlines' Baggage Delivery Guarantee treats a bag as delayed if it is not available at baggage claim within 4 hours of arrival, promises delivery within 24 hours or a $25 voucher for future travel, and reimburses lost bag contents up to $3,500.

The assistant said American Airlines offers trip insurance through its partner Allianz Global Assistance, and a separate Baggage Protection policy covering checked bags up to $1,000 per bag at roughly $12 to $20 per person per trip.
The user is looking to book a new flight from Boston to Miami and is still recovering from an American Airlines flight from LAX to JFK that was delayed by 2 hours due to bad weather.
The user prefers a weekday morning flight, is open to any airline, holds a Delta SkyMiles card, and is willing to consider Fort Lauderdale (FLL) instead of Miami (MIA) for the Boston trip.

The assistant listed weekday morning Boston to Miami (MIA) options: Delta departing 6:00 AM and arriving 9:35 AM via ATL for $158 (earning 2,344 SkyMiles), American departing 7:00 AM via CLT for $173, and JetBlue non-stop departing 8:00 AM for $178.

The assistant listed Boston to Fort Lauderdale (FLL) options: JetBlue non-stop departing 7:00 AM for $148, Spirit non-stop departing 8:30 AM for $123 (basic fare, no checked bag), and Delta via ATL departing 9:00 AM for $183 (earning 2,344 SkyMiles).

The assistant said JetBlue assigns seats randomly at booking, that paid 'Even More Space' seats offer up to 37 inches of legroom for $10 to $25 extra, and that free seat selection opens at check-in, 24 hours before the flight.

The assistant said JetBlue offers 36 channels of free live TV, free Wi-Fi and free snacks such as Terra Chips, animal crackers and peanuts, and that its 'Fly-Fi' entertainment is accessed on personal devices rather than seat-back screens.

The user said they are leaning toward JetBlue from Boston to Fort Lauderdale but are worried about the lack of seat selection and limited amenities, and asked whether JetBlue's in-flight entertainment is better than American Airlines'.

The user decided to take the JetBlue flight from Boston (BOS) to Fort Lauderdale (FLL) and asked the assistant to book it and check whether Delta SkyMiles could upgrade the return flight from FLL to BOS.

The assistant said it had booked JetBlue flight B6 1018 from Boston (BOS) departing 7:00 AM to Fort Lauderdale (FLL) arriving 10:35 AM, with a randomly assigned seat, and that a JetBlue confirmation email would follow.

The assistant said no direct Delta flight from FLL to BOS could be upgraded with SkyMiles, and offered a Delta connection via Atlanta: DL 1242 departing FLL at 5:30 PM and DL 2166 arriving in BOS at 9:35 PM with a one-hour layover.

The assistant said that according to Delta's website, upgrading with SkyMiles requires 15,000 SkyMiles for Comfort+ and 30,000 SkyMiles for First Class, subject to availability, and that upgrade availability is not guaranteed.

The user chose to book the Delta return flight from FLL to BOS in the hope of upgrading with SkyMiles, and asked for reminders to check upgrade options regularly and for a way to be notified when an upgrade becomes available.

The assistant said it had booked the Delta return flight from FLL to BOS via ATL and listed upgrade alert options: Delta app push notifications, Delta account email alerts, and ExpertFlyer custom alerts, noting that none of these notifications is guaranteed.

The user asked about travel insurance for the Boston to Fort Lauderdale trip, and the assistant estimated prices for a 4-day trip per person: trip cancellation $20-$50, trip interruption $15-$30, travel medical $10-$25 and travel delay $10-$20.

The assistant named Allianz Travel Insurance, TravelGuard Insurance, Travelex Insurance Services and Squaremouth Travel Insurance as popular providers, and recommended a policy covering trip cancellation, trip interruption and travel delay for the Boston trip.

The user is planning a Miami trip and wants to redeem Delta SkyMiles for a free trip. Shortly before 17 November 2022 the user had returned from a red-eye JetBlue flight from San Francisco to Boston and managed to sleep for almost the entire flight.

The user has a Delta SkyMiles balance of 10,000 miles, wants a round-trip economy redemption flying out of Boston on a non-stop flight, and is flexible on dates but would prefer to travel in the summer of 2023.
The assistant listed Delta non-stop Boston to Miami redemptions for summer 2023: June 15-22 at 9,500 miles, June 22-29 at 10,000 miles, July 6-13 at 10,000 miles and July 13-20 at 10,500 miles.

The assistant listed further summer 2023 non-stop Boston to Miami redemptions of August 3-10 at 10,000 miles and August 10-17 at 10,500 miles, and noted that these options are subject to availability.

The assistant suggested Fort Lauderdale (FLL) as an alternative airport that might offer more redemption options or lower mileage requirements, and recommended price alerts or ExpertFlyer to monitor availability.
The user said they would check the Delta website for availability and asked about the benefits and requirements of the Citi AAdvantage Executive credit card, which they were considering applying for.

The assistant said the Citi AAdvantage Executive card offers 50,000 AAdvantage miles after $5,000 spend in the first 3 months, 2x miles on American Airlines purchases, 1x mile on other purchases, and carries a $450 annual fee.

The assistant listed Citi AAdvantage Executive perks: Admirals Club access for the cardholder and up to 2 guests, priority check-in, security and boarding, a $100 Global Entry or TSA PreCheck fee credit, 25% off in-flight food, beverages and headsets, and a 10,000-mile anniversary bonus after $40,000 spend.
The assistant said the Citi AAdvantage Executive card typically requires a good to excellent credit score of about 700+ FICO and has no foreign transaction fee.
The user said they think they will apply for the Citi AAdvantage Executive card and try to meet its $5,000 spend requirement.

The user is flying Spirit Airlines to Fort Lauderdale for a spring break trip in March 2023 and asked about Spirit's baggage policies and restrictions.

The assistant said Spirit carry-on bag fees are $30-$45 online and $40-$55 at the airport, checked bag fees are $25-$40 online and $35-$50 at the airport, and overweight bags cost $75-$100, with prices varying by route, booking time and Free Spirit membership.

The assistant said Spirit carry-on bags can be up to 22 x 14 x 9 inches, checked bags are capped at 62 linear inches and 40 pounds, and a free personal item must fit under the seat in front of the passenger.
The user asked for tips on finding affordable accommodation in the Miami area for the trip, including budget hotels or hostels.
The assistant recommended Jazz Hostel and Miami Beach Hostel, both with dorms and private rooms from around $30-40 per night, as budget options for the Miami trip.

The assistant listed Red Roof Inn Miami Airport from around $60-80 per night, Super 8 by Wyndham Miami from $70-90, Hampton Inn & Suites Miami Midtown from $100-120, and Hyatt Place Miami Airport East from $120-140 per night.

The assistant advised booking early, being flexible with dates, visiting in the off-season (usually May-September) for lower rates, checking Expedia, Booking.com or Hotels.com for deals, and reading TripAdvisor, Yelp or Google reviews.

On 15 January 2023 the user earned 10,000 Delta SkyMiles after a round-trip flight from Boston to Atlanta that day, and is planning a free Miami trip later in 2023 that they want to book with the miles.

The assistant said one-way economy flights within the continental United States typically require 5,000-10,000 miles, and round-trip economy flights within the continental United States typically require 10,000-20,000 miles.

The assistant described Delta's award calendar steps: log in to the SkyMiles account, select 'Shop with Miles', enter dates and the BOS to MIA route, click 'Award Calendar' and filter results by miles.
The user said they are pretty flexible with travel dates and will check out the award calendar tool on Delta's website.
The user asked whether they could use Delta SkyMiles to book an American Airlines flight, citing a terrible in-flight entertainment experience on a New York to Los Angeles flight on February 10th.

The assistant said Delta and American Airlines are not airline partners, so Delta SkyMiles cannot be redeemed on American Airlines flights, while Delta partners include LATAM, Air France, KLM and Virgin Atlantic.
The user said they recently got approved for the Citi AAdvantage Executive credit card, which the user described as offering a 50,000-mile bonus after spending $5,000 in the first 3 months.

The user asked whether to focus on earning American Airlines miles or diversify across different airlines, and the assistant said focusing on one program can speed up redemptions while diversifying gives more flexibility and less dependence on one program.

The assistant said American Airlines is part of the Oneworld alliance, which includes British Airways, Cathay Pacific and Qantas, so miles earned with other Oneworld airlines can be redeemed on American Airlines flights.

The assistant said transferable points programs such as Chase Ultimate Rewards and Amex Membership Rewards can be moved to several airline loyalty programs, giving more flexibility in redeeming miles.

The user is considering applying for the Chase Sapphire Preferred card to diversify their miles, having heard that Chase Ultimate Rewards points are highly valued and can be transferred to multiple airline partners.

The assistant said the Chase Sapphire Preferred offers 60,000 bonus points after $4,000 spend in the first 3 months, 2X points on travel and dining, a 25% points bonus when redeemed for travel, and no foreign transaction fees.

The assistant listed alternative cards: Chase Sapphire Reserve with a $300 travel credit, Amex Platinum with a $200 airline fee credit, Citi Premier at 3X points on travel, and Capital One Venture at 2X miles on all purchases.
The assistant listed United MileagePlus, Delta SkyMiles and Hilton Honors as loyalty programs to consider alongside the Chase cards.

The assistant said Chase Sapphire Preferred trip cancellation and interruption insurance reimburses up to $10,000 per person and $20,000 per trip, and travel delay reimbursement pays up to $500 per ticket after a 12-hour flight delay or a 6-hour trip delay.

The assistant described the Chase Ultimate Rewards portal as a place to redeem points for flights, hotels, car rentals and activities, and said the 25% bonus makes points worth about 1.25 cents each when redeemed for travel.
